known.via: English Wikipedia "Graves de Vayres AOC" (redirects to "Graves de Vayres")

rules.yield_base: 53 hl/ha for red, 55 for dry white, 50 for other white

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation for red and white wine, in two communes inside Entre-Deux-Mers. Reds use Merlot and Cabernets, whites use Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle.
